findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key appended as a query parameter (?api_key=IVY26-...)
findings.actual: Query parameter api_key is rejected with 401; key must be supplied via the X-API-Key HTTP header.
findings.how_found: Observed 401 error response stating 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'
findings.impact: All API requests fail with 401 if following the documentation.

findings.documented: Returns token with expires_in 86400 (24 hours) and states there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns access_token with expires_in 900 (15 minutes), refresh_token, and refresh_url /auth/refresh.
findings.how_found: Inspected JSON payload returned by POST /auth/login.
findings.impact: Client applications expire after 15 minutes unless implementing the refresh token flow.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing object.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. The endpoint is plural: GET /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.how_found: Probed singular and plural paths; singular 404s while plural resolves.
findings.impact: Detail pages fail to load if using the singular path.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. The endpoint does not exist on the server.
findings.how_found: Requested the similar endpoint with known valid listing IDs.
findings.impact: Similar listing strip fails if relying on backend endpoint.

findings.documented: User saved listings are managed via GET, POST, DELETE /v1/favourites with body {'id': '...'}.
findings.actual: /v1/favourites returns 404 Not Found. Running endpoint is /v1/saved, POST expects {'listing_id': '...'} and returns 201 Created.
findings.how_found: Probed candidate paths; /v1/saved resolved and returned 422 until listing_id payload was passed.
findings.impact: Favourites operations fail completely when using documented URL and payload format.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for the city.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. The analytics endpoint does not exist.
findings.impact: Insights screen cannot fetch server pre-computed aggregates and must compute them from listings.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page (default 1) and limit (max 200). Response envelope contains total, page, page_size, results.
findings.actual: The page parameter is quietly ignored (always returns offset 0). The API requires offset and limit (capped at max 50). Response envelope has limit, offset, count, total, has_more.
findings.how_found: Paged with page=2 and received identical records to page=1; tested offset and verified pagination works.
findings.impact: Clients using page parameter are stuck in an infinite loop reading page 1.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters. Dividing total by limit gives the page count.
findings.actual: The total field underreports actual retrievable records (reports 3813, but continuing pagination until has_more is false yields 4100 records).
findings.how_found: Paging past the documented total until has_more is false.
findings.impact: Clients stop fetching prematurely and miss 287 valid listing records.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Timestamps carry an explicit +05:30 offset or are local naive timestamps without Z suffix (server timezone is Asia/Kolkata).
findings.how_found: Called /health and inspected posted_at values across all listings.
findings.impact: Parsing timestamps strictly expecting Z suffix causes failures or 5.5 hour timezone calculation errors.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: Project prices are in mixed units: values < 10 are in Crores (x10^7 INR), and values >= 10 are in Lakhs (x10^5 INR). None are in raw rupees.
findings.how_found: Compared project price ranges with prices of listings linked to those projects.
findings.impact: Displays absurd project prices (e.g. Rs 35 to Rs 99 instead of Lakhs/Crores).

findings.documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: On website magichomes, listings with carpet_area < 200 are recorded in square meters rather than square feet.
findings.how_found: Identified 333 listings exclusively on magichomes with carpet area 35-150 whose ratio to super_built_up_area matches square meter measurements.
findings.impact: Displays flats with impossible 70 sqft area and distorts price per sqft calculations by 10.76x.

findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Certain listings have price recorded in thousands of rupees (INR '000) rather than rupees.
findings.how_found: Identified listings with prices like 7240 or 9430 whose price/sqft becomes normal market rate only when scaled by 1000.
findings.impact: Properties appear to cost Rs 7,000 to 15,000 total price.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns both active and inactive listings (867 retrievable listings have is_live = false).
findings.how_found: Inspected distribution of is_live field in response records.
findings.impact: Users are shown inactive and withdrawn listings unless frontend explicitly filters for is_live == true.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: The project_id query parameter is quietly ignored by GET /v1/listings and returns all unfiltered listings.
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings?project_id=P40014 and received listings from completely different projects.
findings.impact: Filter by project fails silently on backend.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with the count of available listings in that project.
findings.actual: For 119 projects, total_listings does not match the count of live listings associated with the project_id.
findings.how_found: Aggregated live listings by project_id and compared with project total_listings field.
findings.impact: Project cards show incorrect available listing counts (including projects showing 0 that have live listings).

findings.documented: Listing records describe physical properties in Chennai.
findings.actual: Exactly 36 listing records describe physical impossibilities: negative prices (9), floor higher than total floors (9), carpet area larger than super built-up area (9), and swapped latitude/longitude placing coordinates in the Arctic Ocean (9).
findings.how_found: Audited numerical constraints and geo-boundaries across all 4100 records.

findings.documented: posted_by_contact is the seller's verified contact number.
findings.actual: Exactly 110 listings are fake lead-generation bait posted across 7 syndicate phone numbers with fictitious agency names (e.g. Dream Space, Urban Nest) and advance-fee scam sentences.
findings.how_found: Identified phone numbers associated with multiple conflicting agency names and advance token phrases.
findings.impact: Users are exposed to advance-fee lead bait scams.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: The same physical flat is listed multiple times across different websites with slightly different prices or names (42 duplicate clusters).
findings.how_found: Grouped properties by exact building, locality, floor, total floors, BHK, facing direction, and normalized area.
findings.impact: Duplicate cards displayed in search results.
